in_marathi.name: Manvika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manvika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘manas’ meaning mind, intellect. It is believed to signify the embodiment of wisdom and intelligence. In Hindu mythology, Manvantara is the current world cycle ruled by Manu, the lawgiver and savior of mankind.
